Definition
[Convex functions vanishing on the boundary] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0456 1. apph:H.32\group Generalized gradients The class $\Xzero (C)$ consists of locally Lipschitz convex functions $f:C\to \R $ on closed connected locally convex sets with nonempty boundary and interior, satisfying $f|_{\partial C}=0$.
